Facts checked on 2026-10-19 against Shimano Specifications handbook Ver. 2.8 (Oct. 7, 2026), Shimano compatibility charts C-254/C-257, C-454, C-731 (Ver 2.7, Oct. 7, 2026) and kmcchain.com. bike.shimano.com product pages were down for maintenance and were not used. Full DM-GN0001 chain-length text not read (search snippet only).
description: SORA R3000 2x9 with RD-R3000-SS, 50-34 and an 11-28 (or smaller) cassette: easiest gear that keeps the SS derailleur is CS-HG400-9 11-32T.

output.summary: RD-R3000-SS can take up to a 32T cog. 11-32 is the easiest gear without changing the derailleur.

requirements.title: Cassette
requirements.reason: Biggest cog the current derailleur allows. Low gear 34x32.

fit_checks.detail: Chart C-257 ticks 11-32T for RD-R3000 SS
Needs 37T capacity (16T front + 21T rear): exactly at the SS limit

alternatives.reason: A step less easy (34x30), with spare derailleur capacity.

requirements.title: Chain
requirements.reason: Bigger cog needs a longer chain. Skip to re-use and re-size.

fit_checks.detail: C-454 lists CN-HG53 for SORA R3000 2x9
Size on largest cog + largest chainring, add 2 links (28T or larger)

alternatives.reason: Higher-grade Shimano 9-speed chain listed for R3000.
KMC states fit for Shimano 9-speed drivetrains.

inferred: Easiest overall would be CS-HG400-9 11-34T, but that needs RD-R3000-GS (C-257). Not included; add it if the customer wants more range.
If the wheel has an 11-speed road freehub body, a 9-speed cassette needs a 1.85 mm spacer (reading of chart C-731).
Chain re-sizing comes from the bigger cog, not from wear.
